en: A caricature-style illustrated postcard showing the profile of an elderly man with a wrinkled face, large nose, and white hair, wearing a tall black top hat with light vertical stripes. The background is a flat green. The drawing is signed at the lower right. At the top left is a printed heading in Portuguese, and at the bottom are a caption with the man's name and the publisher's information.
